顾承安在门口给房东打了个电话。

等了几分钟，一个五十来岁、烫着卷发的阿姨走了出来。

“小伙子是你啊？跟我来。”

坐电梯上了十六楼，1603。

阿姨推开门，顾承安走进去扫了一眼。

客厅不大，大概十五平，但采光不错，南向的窗户正对着小区花园。

卧室放了张一米五的床，衣柜、书桌都有，虽然是老款式，但干净。

厨房是开放式的，灶台、抽油烟机、冰箱齐全，可以自己做饭。

有一个小卫生间，热水器也有，够用了。

“阿姨，这套多少？”

“两千二一个月，押一付三。”

顾承安心里算了一下。押一付三就是八千八。他卡里目前还有两千出头，差得远。

不过花呗额度还有六千多，之前一直没怎么用过，偶尔发工资前的时候应个急。现在正好派上用场，等奖金到了再还上。

“阿姨，能不能便宜点？我长租，至少住一年。”

阿姨上下打量了他一眼：“你做什么工作的？”

“送外卖的。”

阿姨的表情微妙地变了一下，那种“送外卖的能不能按时交租”的犹豫写在脸上。

顾承安太熟悉这种眼神了，笑了笑说：“阿姨您放心，我每个月收入稳定，不拖租。而且我一个人住，不抽烟不喝酒不养宠物，爱干净，不会把房子搞得乱七八糟。”

阿姨想了想：“两千一，不能再少了。”

“成交。”

顾承安当场用花呗扫了七千四，积蓄付了一千。

剩下一千来块自己这两天使用。

阿姨收到钱后，脸上的笑容立刻真诚了几分，麻利地把钥匙和门禁卡递给他，又交代了物业费、水电气之类的事情。

送走阿姨，顾承安关上门，往沙发上一坐，长长地呼了口气。

舒服。

他拿出手机，准备列个搬家清单。床上用品得买新的，锅碗瓢盆也得添置，还有……

他先回了趟握手楼那边的出租房，收拾了下东西，其实也没啥东西可带的。

就一台笔记本电脑，两套换洗的衣物。

还有一些大学的证书啥的。

Gu Chengan called the landlord at the door.

After waiting for a few minutes, an aunt in her fifties with permed and curly hair came out.

"Is that you, young man? Come with me."

Take the elevator to the sixteenth floor, 1603.

The aunt opened the door and Gu Chengan walked in and took a quick look.

The living room is not big, about 15 square meters, but it has good lighting. The south-facing windows face the community garden.

The bedroom has a 1.5-meter bed, a wardrobe, and a desk. Although it is an old style, it is clean.

The kitchen is open and equipped with a stove, range hood, and refrigerator, so you can cook your own meals.

There is a small bathroom and a water heater, which is enough.

"Auntie, how much is this set?"

"Two thousand two thousand a month, one deposit and three payments."

Gu Chengan did the math in his mind.Betting one and paying three is eight thousand eighty.He is still in his early 2000s in Kali, which is far from enough.

However, the Huabei quota is still over 6,000, and I have never used it much before. I occasionally use it for emergencies before wages are paid.It just comes in handy now, and I'll pay it back when the bonus arrives.

"Auntie, can it be cheaper? I'll rent it for a long time, at least for a year."

The aunt looked him up and down: "What do you do?"

"The food delivery guy."

The aunt's expression changed subtly, and the hesitation of "Can the delivery person pay the rent on time?" was written on her face.

Gu Chengan was very familiar with this look and smiled and said, "Don't worry, Auntie, my monthly income is stable and I won't miss the rent. And I live alone. I don't smoke, drink, or keep pets. I love cleanliness and won't make the house a mess."

The aunt thought for a while: "Two thousand one, no more."

"Deal."

Gu Chengan paid 7,400 yuan with Huabei on the spot and paid 1,000 yuan from his savings.

I have about a thousand dollars left for myself to use in the past two days.

After the aunt received the money, the smile on her face immediately became a little more sincere. She quickly handed him the keys and access card, and explained the property fees, water, electricity and other matters.

After seeing his aunt off, Gu Chengan closed the door, sat on the sofa, and exhaled a long breath.

Comfortable.

He took out his cell phone and prepared to make a moving list.New bedding had to be bought, pots and pans had to be purchased, and...

He first went back to the rental house at the handshake building and packed his things. In fact, he didn't have anything to bring.

Just a laptop and two sets of clothes.

There are also some university certificates and so on.
